# Public SDK snapshot

`actionlint-extension-api` is based on the public SDK from actionlint commit
`99a250b29aaadfdb2d95a0c6ab954d3f9f11bdc8`,
including its MIT license. The [snapshot manifest](actionlint-extension-api.snapshot.json)
records source blobs and file hashes. The files match that revision without local changes. It contains no
host implementation or sibling-checkout dependency. Update the SDK as a unit;
do not update generated protocol sources independently.
